unit: The USA 1945-1974: The People and the State
title: The post-war Red Scare

items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio walkthrough of the post-war Red Scare — Hoover, HUAC, the Rosenbergs and anti-Communist paranoia from 1947.

items.title: What is McCarthyism? And how did it happen? — Ellen Schrecker
items.description: TED-Ed animation on McCarthyism and the Red Scare — how fear of Communism reshaped American politics. 5 min.

items.title: Civil Rights and the 1950s: Crash Course US History #39
items.description: Covers the Cold War domestic context including HUAC and how the Red Scare intersected with civil rights. 14 min.

items.title: Good Night, and Good Luck (2005)
items.description: Journalist Ed Murrow takes on McCarthyism — the most powerful film about the Red Scare, shot in black and white.

items.title: Bridge of Spies (2015)
items.description: Cold War spy swap — captures the paranoia and legal tensions of the Red Scare era through a real case.

items.title: PBS American Experience — The Red Scare and Cold War
items.description: PBS archive including documentary material on HUAC, the Rosenbergs and the post-war Red Scare.

items.description: Official OCR J411 spec — check the assessment criteria for the USA People and the State unit.
